authorization: User option 1: one focused final independent Claude review; bounded review-routing exception.

findings: MINOR - cylinder_diagnostic_snapshot_v2.py:248 returns enumeration_complete=True unconditionally while the same record carries enumeration_limitation ('Pre-yield disappearance may omit identities', lines 225-226) and a possibly non-empty errors list / selected_details_complete=False. The completeness claim is stronger than the evidence. Non-blocking because the pressure admission path gates on classification.status == 'CLEAR' (cylinder_pressure_resources.py:63) and never reads enumeration_complete. Remedy: remove the field or derive it from an actual predicate such as 'not errors'.

MINOR - cylinder_preparation_history.py:60 (_refusal) admits arbitrary extra top-level keys: after canonical-comparing only the eight fields in 'expected', the sole additional guard is any(k.endswith('_error') for k in result). A top-level 'error' is intentionally permitted, but so is any differently-named failure field, and nested failure evidence under preclaim_probe / capture is never inspected. Remedy: validate the refusal against an exact allowed top-level key set rather than a suffix heuristic, and recurse the *_error scan one level into preclaim_probe.

MINOR - Retained-preparation poisoning has no in-code remediation path. If _terminal_records fails before writing preparation-refusal.json (preparation_record_error / PREPARATION_RETENTION_INCOMPLETE) or the process dies after output.mkdir (state.update(output=...) follows mkdir in cylinder_pressure_resume.py), the root is in the campaign namespace but can never satisfy _preparation ('Retained preparation refusal missing') and cannot be omitted (set(roots) != observed). Likewise _preparation's streams[stderr] != b'' refusal means any uncaught traceback from main() - including from the new verify_streams(config) raise sites - permanently disqualifies that run's stream pair. Fail-closed but unrecoverable. Remedy: document the manual quarantine/retirement procedure, or add a reviewed digest-pinned retirement declaration analogous to LEGACY_PREPARATIONS.

MINOR - The stdout receipt's final bytes are never verified in-run although next-run ingestion requires exact equality. run_pressure_diagnostic.py main does verify_streams(config) then print(canonical_bytes(result).decode('utf-8')) with no flush/fsync/read-back, unlike write_exclusive (cylinder_pressure_journal.py:20-28) which fsyncs and readback-compares every on-disk record. _preparation later requires canonical_bytes(parse_json(streams[stdout])) == canonical_bytes(refusal), so a short write, truncated shutdown buffer or appended second invocation silently converts a valid preparation into the dead end described above. Remedy: after print, flush and os.fsync(sys.stdout.fileno()), then re-read the bound stdout path and compare against canonical_bytes(result), failing loudly on mismatch.

VERIFIED (not a defect) - The prior blocking finding is closed. verify_streams (cylinder_preparation_streams.py:45-52) resolves sys.stdout/sys.stderr via os.fstat and os.path.samestat against S_ISREG, st_ino and st_nlink == 1 on both handle and name (_same_file:33-42), and is reached before reservation acquisition, inside history_binding/account_storage, at refusal retention (_terminal_records) and before the stdout receipt. An attempt to de-anchor the declared preparation's lineage.original_root so that _refusal_identity's expected_stream_paths(original) would name a different _coordination directory than _streams(config, output) enumerates fails: expected_stream_paths refuses unless output.parent == original.parent, _preparation forces root.parent == parent, and _namespace forces parent == current original_root.parent, so the grandparents coincide. Omission is closed by the two set-equality gates plus the stdout-content-equals-refusal check. Config closure mutation is closed by the single deepcopy in production_callbacks and the frozen copies in history_binding/history_storage.

SCOPE - Native execution, licence, capacity, current resource ownership and stopping criteria are not waived and were not re-derived; 2/2 native attempts and the 64 null coarse-pressure responses were taken as frozen reference, not recomputed. Exact serialized path spelling remains fail-closed (owned_path's path == path.resolve() versus _checked_path's os.path.abspath can diverge on case or short names and refuses rather than normalizes), consistent with the stated F4 limitation. Regression evidence (887 passed, 2 skipped) was read as reported, not executed, and tests are not treated as approval. This is a diagnostic software review only; no human engineering checker identity and no engineering qualification is established.

dispositions: Completeness wording: retained limitation and downstream CLEAR requirement remain. No stronger enumeration or absence claim is made.

Refusal schema: exact typed settlement/zero-launch fields, identity/digest pins and inventory equality remain mandatory. Arbitrary metadata does not grant native or reuse authority; broader schema tightening is deferred.

Incomplete preparation: no automatic quarantine, retirement, deletion or namespace omission is authorized by this code. Incomplete evidence refuses; any future recovery requires a separately reviewed digest-pinned disposition while retaining originals. Current retained preparation passes.

Final stdout durability: in-run final readback remains unimplemented. The parent execution evidence workflow shall verify retained output after process exit before publication or future intake. Missing/truncated output remains incomplete, never qualified.
limits: No native execution admission from this review alone.
Fresh runtime/configuration review, licence, resource ownership, capacity and stop checks remain required.
No engineering qualification. Earlier MAJOR verdicts remain historical; the earlier disposition is not rewritten.
